configuration.ablation: Validation-selected combined method/parameters held fixed; remove predefined source groups; same populations and preprocessing fit on train only
configuration.artist_history_cutoff: chart_date strictly less than focal debut; process entire date as one batch
configuration.bootstrap: Paired fixed-model resampling by exact full artist credit and by debut year; percentile 95% intervals; no model-selection uncertainty
configuration.complete_followup: global last observed chart date >= exclusive horizon end
configuration.duplicate_policy: Preserve every source row; points sum source rows; weeks count distinct dates; minimum rank resolves song/date only for rank changes
configuration.historical_backtest_method: Prespecified HGB leaf_nodes=15,120 iterations; threshold selected in preceding five-year validation interval; no later model choice reused
configuration.longevity: at least ceil(horizon/2) distinct chart dates within horizon
configuration.numerical_targets: best observed rank, distinct chart-date count, and source-row sum(101-rank) within fixed horizon; includes known debut contribution
configuration.partitions: Debut in assigned period AND entire target window ends by next boundary; horizon-crossing identities purged
configuration.permutation_population: Validation only; rankings not chosen from test
configuration.prediction_moment: Immediately after publication of first observed Billboard chart; all rows of that chart available
configuration.preprocessing: Training-only median imputation without availability indicators, standardization, and observed-category one-hot encoding; unknown category all zero
configuration.probability_calibration: No fitted recalibration; report raw probabilities, Brier, log loss, ECE and reliability bins
configuration.retrospective_baseline: 42 frozen scores, primary genre, consistent single-valued matched duration and debut rank; no acquisition, final-success, release-date or catalog-count predictors
configuration.retrospective_track: Final enriched identities with all 42 existing scores and usable structural text; same rows across A/B/C; modern content and credit proxies remain F
configuration.strict_track: All weekly entrants with eligible complete follow-up; A=known debut rank; B=new A-C features only; C=union
configuration.top10_eligibility: debut best observed rank > 10; songs already Top 10 are resolved and excluded
configuration.tuning: Train before 2010; validation 2010-2017 only. Select classification by balanced accuracy, then Brier; regression by MAE. Final selected estimator remains training-only, no validation refit.
configuration.unit: Exact original title + full artist credit; no automatic identity merge
